title: Providing the ontology is not the same as the agent using it
question: When an agent writes a query badly, was the information it was given wrong, or did it not use the information?
hypothesis: End accuracy cannot separate those two, and they have opposite remedies. Whether supplied information shaped a query leaves a mechanical trace in the query itself, so utilisation can be counted rather than inferred from the score.
still_needed: a question set built from the graph, answerable and unanswerable, so an empty result can be read
the query-writing agent itself, run under each description
the utilisation traces, one per supplied element
